Downloaded 2026-09-13. Original mesh, UVs, diffuse texture and 30-frame flight rig preserved.
Changes: converted from Blender to FBX using Blender 4.3.2, restored legacy diffuse texture node, renamed flight clip Flight, excluded scene lights/cameras. Unity materials and scale/pivot adaptation by KeyLearner.
